meta_description: New Dimensions is a professional painter and decorator in Southampton and Eastleigh. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating services. Free quotes.
hero_subhead: Transform your home inside and out. Expert painting, decorating, and wallpapering across Southampton and Eastleigh.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services in Southampton
services_subhead: From full house redecorations to specialist finishes, we handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Complete interior makeovers including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prepare surfaces properly and use premium paints for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with professional exterior painting. Fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered walls all finished to withstand Southampton's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and bespoke wall coverings, from traditional patterns to contemporary designs. Precision work on any wall condition.

services.title: Furniture & Cabinet Painting
services.desc: Refresh tired furniture, kitchen cabinets, and fitted wardrobes with professional spray or brush finishes. Durable, smooth results that transform your space.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Textured coatings, faux finishes, and decorative effects tailored to your taste. Create depth and character in any room.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and rental properties painted efficiently and to schedule. Minimal disruption, professional results, fast turnaround.

about_pullquote: We believe a fresh coat of paint should last, look brilliant, and be done right first time.
about_para_1: New Dimensions was founded on the principle that quality decorating shouldn't come with hidden costs or corner-cutting. With over 15 years' experience painting and decorating homes across Southampton and Eastleigh, we've built a reputation for meticulous preparation, attention to detail, and reliable service. Every job, whether a small bedroom refresh or a full house redecoration, receives the same care and professionalism.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we turn up on time, protect your home, and deliver results that enhance the way your space looks and feels. We work closely with you throughout the project to understand your vision—then bring it to life with quality materials and skilled craftsmanship. Many of our jobs come from recommendations and repeat customers who know they can rely on us.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge and hallway. Mark was really professional, didn't make a mess, and the finish is perfect. Already planning to have him back for the bedrooms next year.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen cabinets painted and they look like new. The prep work was thorough and the finish is so smooth. Took less time than expected and very tidy throughout. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rebecca T.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on exterior woodwork and got a same-day visit. No pressure, honest advice, and the price was fair. Work started promptly and finished on schedule. Will use them again for the interior.
reviews.author: James M.
